name: Terraria TShock Server
description: Password-protected Terraria 1.4.5.8 server with persistent worlds.

PORT.description: Private readiness HTTP port; keep 8080, with no public HTTP domain.

SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Generated game join password; use 16–128 printable ASCII characters when overriding.

WORLD_NAME.description: New world display name, 1–40 ASCII letters, numbers, spaces, underscores or hyphens.

WORLD_SIZE.description: New worlds only: 1 small, 2 medium, 3 large; small uses the least RAM.

DIFFICULTY.description: New worlds only: 0 classic, 1 expert, 2 master, 3 journey.

MAX_PLAYERS.description: Maximum concurrent players, 1–32; more players require more RAM and CPU.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Give the game server time to save its world before shutdown.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_OVERLAP_SECONDS.description: Avoid overlapping game processes writing the same world volume.
